title: Israeli drone strike kills 2 Palestinians in Gaza, and other Mideast news
summary_or_snippet: The Associated Press reports that a drone strike killed two Palestinians walking in Jabaliya, according to Shifa Hospital's director; a field hospital reported several other wounded people, and the Israeli military said it struck two Hamas militants. title: ISRAEL/PALESTINE: Statement by the High Representative on behalf of the European Union on the humanitarian developments in Gaza
summary_or_snippet: The European Union says flooding and winter conditions are worsening Gaza's humanitarian crisis, calls for protection of civilians and medical facilities, urges immediate unimpeded aid access and reopening of all crossings, and says the recent Nasser Hospital airstrike is deeply alarming.

title: Urgent appeal to expedite the entry of winter supplies into Gaza
summary_or_snippet: In its November 13 appeal, OCHA's Humanitarian Country Team says more than 150,000 tents procured by humanitarian partners and Member States are outside Gaza, most in Al Arish, while approval, crossing capacity, delivery-window and funding barriers delay entry. It calls for expedited winter supplies, water and wastewater repairs, humanitarian access and funding. This is dated November 13 context, not a November 14 tally or confirmation that supplies arrived.
